rMVPA runtime options

Source: R/options.R
rMVPA-options.Rd

Options read with getOption() by the package at run time. Set them with options(name = value). Each default below is used when the option is unset. Byte budgets are plain numbers of bytes.

Details

rMVPA.regional_mem_budget

Default 2e9 (2 GB). Peak extraction-memory budget, in bytes, for one batch of regional ROIs. The batch size is reduced when the estimated per-batch memory exceeds it.

rMVPA.searchlight_mem_budget

Default 512 * 1024^2 (512 MiB). Memory budget, in bytes, used to pick the automatic batch size for searchlight centers.

rMVPA.searchlight_min_chunk

Default 16L. Lower bound, in centers, on the chunk size used when searchlight centers are split across workers. A chunk is still capped by the centers per worker.

rMVPA.gc_each_batch

Default FALSE. When TRUE, the iterator calls gc() after every batch. Off by default because a full collection is costly; use it to lower peak memory in long runs.

rMVPA.shard_gc_each_batch

Default FALSE. Older alias of rMVPA.gc_each_batch, honoured by the iterator and the shard backend.

rMVPA.profile_searchlight

Default FALSE. When TRUE, searchlight runs record setup and timing information in the "timing" attribute of the result.

rMVPA.debug

Default FALSE. When TRUE, the searchlight combiner resolution reports extra diagnostic information.

rMVPA.rsa_perm_cache_bytes

Default 512 * 1024^2 (512 MiB). Maximum size, in bytes, of the RSA permutation cache. When the cache for a run would exceed this, it is not used.

rMVPA.rsa_fast_parallel

Default TRUE. Allows the fast RSA searchlight engine to run its chunks in parallel when more than one worker is available and there are at least 256 centers. Set to FALSE to force serial execution.

rMVPA.feature_rsa_block_target_bytes

Default 128 * 1024^2 (128 MiB). Target size, in bytes, of one feature-RSA block. Non-finite or non-positive values fall back to the default.

rMVPA.feature_rsa_block_max_cols

Default 64L. Upper bound on the number of columns in one feature-RSA block.

rMVPA.feature_rsa_metric_block_rows

Default 128L. Number of rows processed per block when computing feature-RSA metrics. It is clamped to the number of observations.

rMVPA.feature_rsa_component_target_bytes

Default 32 * 1024^2 (32 MiB). Target size, in bytes, of one block of components when predicting feature-RSA models with a PLS/PCR fit.

Options that are not listed here are not read by rMVPA.
